extra: TFT RST 直接接 3V，用软件复位指令代替，省一个 pin。
玩家板用 TFT 显示，不需要板载 LED 点阵：停用点阵后 P3、P4、P6、P7、P10 空出 P3、P4、P6、P7、P10（其中 P3、P4、P10 支持 ADC）；P3 计划接 DFPlayer TX。
板载传感器和喇叭不占边缘引脚：加速度计在 micro:bit 内部的 I2C 上（计划给潮影用），喇叭在 P0.00（PWM）。

en.note: Draft: the player-board pin assignment hasn't been finalized with Binqi yet; please double-check before wiring.
extra: TFT RST is tied straight to 3V and a software reset command is used instead, which saves a pin.
Player boards display on the TFT and don't need the on-board LED matrix: with the matrix disabled, P3, P4, P6, P7 and P10 are free (P3, P4 and P10 support ADC); P3 is planned for the DFPlayer TX.
The on-board sensors and speaker take no edge pins: the accelerometer is on the micro:bit's internal I2C (planned for Tide) and the speaker is on P0.00 (PWM).
